headlines.title: 国务院：目标到2030年，社会消费品零售总额达到60万亿元左右
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月13日讯，国务院批复《扩大消费“十五五”规划》，目标到2030年，消费市场总体规模持续扩大，居民消费率明显提高，全社会商品和服务消费较快增长，社会消费品零售总额达到60万亿元左右，消费对经济增长的拉动作用进一步增强。消费结构更加优化，居民人均服务性消费支出占居民人均消费支出的比重稳步提高，发展型、改善型消费持续增长，数字消费规模不断扩大，城乡、区域、群体间消费差距逐步缩小。消费能力不断提高，高质量充分就业取得新进展，居民收入增长和经济增长同步，社会保障制度更加优化更可持续，居民消费底气更足、预期更稳、信心更强。

headlines.title_en: State Council: Targets total retail sales of consumer goods to reach approx. 60 trillion yuan by 2030
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data July 13 - The State Council approved the '15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption', aiming to continuously expand the overall scale of the consumer market by 2030, significantly increase the household consumption rate, achieve rapid growth in consumption of goods and services across society, with total retail sales of consumer goods reaching around 60 trillion yuan, further enhancing consumption's role in driving economic growth. The consumption structure will be more optimized, with the share of per capita service consumption expenditure steadily rising, developmental and improvement-oriented consumption growing, digital consumption expanding, and consumption gaps between urban and rural areas, regions, and groups gradually narrowing. Consumption capacity will improve, new progress will be made in high-quality full employment, household income growth will be synchronized with economic growth, the social security system will be more optimized and sustainable, and residents will have a stronger foundation, more stable expectations, and greater confidence in consumption.

headlines.title_en: State Council: Deepen 'AI + consumption', increase effective supply of next-gen smart terminal products including AI smartphones and computers, smart wearables, intelligent robots, and desktop 3D printing devices
headlines.summary_en: The State Council approved the '15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption' to promote high-quality development of digital consumption, deeply advance 'AI + consumption', and implement a digital consumption enhancement initiative. Expand digital product consumption by increasing the effective supply of new-generation intelligent terminal products such as AI phones and computers, smart wearables, intelligent robots, and desktop-level 3D printing devices; accelerate R&D and interconnectivity of smart security and video care systems; and conduct pilot programs for access and road operations of intelligent connected vehicles. Enhance digital service consumption by leveraging AI and virtual reality technologies to empower lifestyle services and scenic areas, promote the integrated application of AI in education, healthcare, culture, tourism, and sports, and expand application scenarios for intelligent agents. Innovate digital content consumption by launching more high-quality digital cultural and museum products, enhancing the supply of ultra-high-definition content for radio, television, and online audiovisual services, and developing virtual reality films.

headlines.summary_en: Aluminum Corporation of China announced that it expects net profit attributable to shareholders of the parent company for the first half of 2026 to be between RMB 11.2 billion and RMB 12.2 billion, an increase of 58% to 73% year-on-year. headlines.title_en: A-share market close: Shanghai Composite opens low and falls over 2%, over 4,600 stocks decline across the market
headlines.summary_en: The market opened low and continued to decline, with all three major indices falling. The helium gas concept bucked the trend and strengthened, with Jiu Feng Energy and Shuifa Gas hitting the daily limit. Traditional Chinese medicine stocks were active during the session, with Longshengrongfa, Jiuzhitang, and Tianmu Pharmaceutical hitting the limit. On the downside, semiconductor and chip stocks fell, with GigaDevice and Xiangnong Xinchuang among many hitting the limit; computing power hardware stocks saw a major adjustment, with Shengyi Technology and Jin'an Guoji hitting the limit. Stocks generally declined, with over 4,600 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets turning green, and today's trading volume exceeded 2.83 trillion yuan. By the close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 2.06%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 3.48%, and the ChiNext Index fell 3.1%.

headlines.title: 国务院：因城施策增加改善性住房供给 持老旧房屋适老化改造和智能化升级
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月13日讯，国务院批复《扩大消费“十五五”规划》，规划提到，促进大宗耐用商品消费。更好满足住房消费需求，优化保障性住房供给，因城施策增加改善性住房供给，规范发展住房租赁市场。实施房屋品质提升工程，建设安全舒适绿色智慧的“好房子”，稳步推进城中村、危旧房和城镇老旧小区改造，支持居民自主更新，支持老旧房屋适老化改造和智能化升级。实施物业服务质量提升行动，拓展物业服务内容。扩大汽车消费，推进汽车流通消费领域全链条创新发展，促进二手车流通，拓展汽车改装、租赁、赛事及房车露营等汽车后市场消费。支持家居家电消费智能化升级，发展新一代智能终端，促进智能家居设

headlines.title_en: State Council: Increase supply of improved housing based on city-specific policies, support renovation and smart upgrades for older homes
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data July 13 - The State Council approved the '15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption'. The plan mentions promoting consumption of major durable goods. Better meet housing consumption needs, optimize the supply of affordable housing, increase the supply of improvement-oriented housing according to city-specific policies, and regulate the development of the housing rental market. Implement a housing quality improvement project to build safe, comfortable, green, and smart 'good houses'; steadily advance the renovation of urban villages, dilapidated houses, and old residential communities; support residents in self-renewal; and support the age-appropriate renovation and intelligent upgrade of old houses. Implement an action to improve property service quality and expand property service content. Expand automobile consumption, promote innovative development across the entire chain of the automobile circulation and consumption field, facilitate the circulation of used cars, and expand consumption in the post-market automotive sector such as car modification, rental, events, and RV camping. Support intelligent upgrades in home and furniture appliance consumption, develop new-generation intelligent terminals, and promote smart home devices.

headlines.title: China’s central bank vows flexible approach as it acknowledges uneven economic picture
headlines.summary:

headlines.summary_zh: 中国人民银行在周三发布的声明中承诺维持“适度宽松”的货币政策，同时呼吁采取更具前瞻性、灵活性和针对性的方式，并首次将“结构性分化”列为国内关键挑战。这些言论出自中国人民银行货币政策委员会一次会议的通稿。
